svg.title: rmsnorm shapes
svg.text: each token's row is divided by its own root-mean-square, then scaled by a learned weight per feature
x · rsqrt(mean(x²) + ε): [N, 2048] (RMS of each row is now 1)
the row is copied down the N tokens

g.text: the row is copied down the N tokens

svg.text: Tokens never mix: row i only uses row i.
so the stretch in step 4 lines up by row.
